title: From Signal to PR: Anatomy of a Self-Improving Agent — Jason Lopatecki, Arize
talk_summary: Arize's founder describes 'Signal', a system that periodically runs a coding-agent harness (Claude Code, etc.) in a sandbox against production traces/logs plus the repo, and files an issue or PR with evidence pre-attached so humans move from responder to reviewer. The key mechanism is well-designed, composable 'skills' that pull the right telemetry into the repo as files, plus periodic/event triggers and online LLM-judge evals layered on traces.

takeaways.technique: Skills that materialize telemetry into repo files
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of pointing the agent at a data source, they write skills that fetch the relevant traces/logs and drop them as files (sometimes ~10MB) into the repo so the harness can reason over code+evidence together.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Getting that data into the repo in a file format. These harnesses are magical with files.

takeaways.technique: Online LLM-judge evals on traces, then promote failures to evals
takeaways.what_they_do: Run LLM-as-judge evals continuously over production traces; when a recurring failure is found, codify it as a new evaluator so it is caught next time.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you build an eval for a failure you've seen before... I can create an eval so I can catch it next time

takeaways.technique: Periodic + event-triggered background agent that files issues with evidence
takeaways.what_they_do: A background agent runs on a schedule or on error events, investigates, and opens a GitHub issue/PR with the evidence already attached, so a human (or another agent) starts from a cold start with context.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the agent is actually... putting up an issue. It's looking at the data before a human even looks at it

takeaways.technique: Pluggable sandbox/harness decoupled from the loop
takeaways.what_they_do: The loop is harness- and sandbox-agnostic: pick Claude Code or another harness, and run it in a VPC-local sandbox, Daytona, or managed agents, so production data never leaves the customer's environment.

They emphasize designing skills so the agent can decide what data it needs and compose them, rather than dumping raw data at the model; skills encode domain queries (cohort by customer, memory facets).
takeaways.evidence_quote: you've got to kind of design the skill surface area in a way that Claude can really really work well

takeaways.technique: Human/agent moves from responder to reviewer with pre-built evidence
takeaways.what_they_do: The loop inverts so the agent does the investigation and cold-start, and the human (or gating agent) only reviews a fix that already has evidence attached; bigger fixes still need a human to drive.
takeaways.evidence_quote: your job kind of moves from responder to reviewer
